Section2.title: Why Choose Biofactor for Poultry?
Section2.description: At Biofactor, our mission is to empower sustainable farming through innovative biotechnology, ensuring animal health and growth naturally.

points.text: Comprehensive Nutrition: Our poultry solutions provide a balanced blend of essential nutrients, including vitamins, minerals, and amino acids, to support overall health and productivity.
Immune Support: We incorporate probiotics and antioxidants to strengthen the immune system, helping birds resist diseases and recover faster from illnesses.
Growth Enhancement: Our formulations are designed to promote optimal growth rates, improve feed conversion ratios, and enhance muscle development for better meat quality.
Egg Production: We focus on improving egg quality and production rates by providing nutrients that support reproductive health and shell strength.
Sustainability: Our products are developed with sustainability in mind, promoting eco-friendly farming practices that reduce environmental impact while maintaining high productivity.

largeAnimals.description: Large animals include cows, buffaloes, and goats, known for milk and meat production.
